title: Collaboration, Review, Adaptation & Publication Workflow
objective: Extend the prepared MAS Adventure workspace with deterministic collaboration, review, adaptation and publication-workflow preparation over MAS-01..19 while preserving canonical owner/resource/publication authority and keeping review, adaptation and publication proposals distinct from actual canonical publication or mutation.

scope.purpose: Represent deterministic Adventure collaboration/review/adaptation/publication workflow structures without treating collaboration proposals, review approvals, adaptation proposals or publication plans as proof that canonical publication or owner mutation occurred.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically prepare collaboration, review, adaptation and publication-workflow structures over completed MAS foundations with explicit owner references and fail-closed invalid states while preserving canonical owner/resource/publication authority and never treating prepared review, approval, adaptation or publication workflow artifacts as proof that canonical publication or mutation occurred.

selection_boundaries: MAS-01 through MAS-19 remain completed foundations and were not reopened.

MAS-20 consumed explicit MAS-19 prepared package references plus validated D29 AuthoringProposalReviewPort, AuthoringAuthorityPort, D28 AdventureDefinitionPort and D29 ReuseRemixTransformationPort owner bindings; invalid bindings, owner-domain mismatches and dangling MAS-19 workflow references fail closed.

Prepared collaboration/review/adaptation/publication workflow structures never recorded review decisions, applied adaptations, published Adventure versions, performed canonical promotion or mutated canonical owner state.
Production code remained frozen after minimum GREEN eee7df920cd9c245ca5883a23dc5dd67d2a777fe; the proof layer added governance/compliance/verifier surfaces only.
Existing MAS validation family remained active; no family transition occurred in MAS-20.
ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json was reconsulted after MAS-20, including current MSLR/MSWI planning; MAS-20 completion unlocks no new cross-program rotation, so MAS-21 is selected_not_started.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MSAS, SMB-08 and post-MAS work were not implemented by this tranche.
next_action: MAS-20 is closed. MAS-21 is selected_not_started after ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
